objects.status: Mathematically rejected shortcut; not a general obstruction.
objects.failed_claim: The Jacobi matrix built directly from mu always has thermal correlator [C_mu(tau)+C_mu(beta-tau)]/[1+C_mu(beta)].
objects.exact_difference: At tau=beta/2, let a_i=1+exp(-beta*omega_i), k_i=sech(beta*omega_i/2). Desired normalized-block value minus unweighted-Jacobi value equals (a_1-a_2)(k_1-k_2)/(2(a_1+a_2))>0 for omega_1<omega_2.
objects.scope: Only this unweighted lifting claim fails. Thermal weighting before Jacobi construction earns the required local law. This mismatch alone gives no general prediction lower bound.

retained_boundaries: Independent hopping rounding does not preserve exact isospectrality. The main construction rounds weights at exact common atoms, then stores exact rational diagonals and square roots of rational hopping squares.
Supplying actual microscopic coefficients changes the observation contract and permits cheap prediction for the constructed chains.
